Support the DeHub ecosystem

About DeHub

DeHub is a non-profit, decentralised, user-owned protocol. All net profit is used to buy back and share DeHub tokens with stakeholders.

All revenue is spent in accordance with DAO proposals, ensuring 100% reinvestment into the ecosystem. DeHub will forever be maintained as a public good through revenue and donations.

Contribute through the DAO

The EVM address above is the DAO treasury. Send DeHub tokens to it from the app and your contribution is counted towards your share of the pool, which is the weight your vote carries when the DAO decides how it is spent.
